note: Input of scripts/component-feature-matrix.mjs. breadthFeatures: features expected to cover every component, each made of one or more Playwright projects; pageScan = whole-page checks, which cover every component the opened page renders; an empty breadth cell is a gap unless notApplicable gives the reason. ambiguousNames: component names that are also ordinary words in titles; they count only at the start of a title segment before a separator. titleAliases: title text -> component, for titles that name a component another way. notApplicable: [{components, features, reason}]. clientWidgets: themed widgets with no component tag, added as rows. projectComponents: project -> components every one of its tests exercises (a single-component project whose fixture URL the page finder cannot attribute).

notApplicable.reason: Renders no box of its own: a macro wrapper, a zuti condition or a <style> element.
No preview page: the hbox/vbox base, replaced by hlayout/vlayout.
Structural or non-visual page, skipped by the gallery scans (SKIP in gallery-scan.spec.ts, forced-colors-gallery.spec.ts and TABLET_SKIP in tablet.spec.ts).
Non-deterministic content (a device, an external resource or an animation), skipped by the page scans; render-smoke and media.spec.ts cover the pages that have one.
